Hi, I'm Miguel Silva. I write here mostly about statistics, data science and AI,
though some of my other passions may show up too.

My background is in software engineering, but I've spent my whole career as a data
scientist. These days I work in marketing science.

Launching this blog is something I've wanted to do for a while, and AI helped me get
it off the ground. I'm also using it to recover some of my older posts and update
them. For me, that's the most interesting part: going back to see what I knew at some
point, and how much my way of thinking has changed over the years.

So join me, and let's learn a bit more together.
